title: Yellow Brown Greek Beef Stifado
description: A traditional Greek dish made with beef, onions, and a sweet and spicy sauce, served as a solo dinner, this stifado is salty, snappy and ayurvedic-tamasic-friendly.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large oven-safe pot over medium-high heat.
Add the beef strips and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the sliced onions and cook until they start to caramelize, about 8 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the ground allspice, ground cinnamon, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Add the red wine vinegar, tomato paste, and water, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then cover the pot and transfer it to the oven.
Broil the stifado in the oven at 400 degrees Fahrenheit for 20 minutes.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it cool slightly.
Serve the stifado hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
